description:
Perform a legal discovery audit on contributor 'Justin Mason' (email: jm@jmason.org). You must separate his direct communications from third-party discussions about him.

1. Create a folder named 'Dossier-Mason'.
2. Inside it (or as separate folders), create two sub-folders: 'Direct' and 'Mentions'.
3. Move all emails SENT BY 'jm@jmason.org' into the 'Direct' folder.
4. Move all emails that MENTION 'Justin Mason' or 'jmason' in the body/subject BUT ARE NOT SENT BY HIM into the 'Mentions' folder. (Crucial: Do not put his own emails in the Mentions folder).
5. Draft an email to 'legal-audit@company.com' with subject 'Discovery Audit: Justin Mason' reporting the exact number of emails found in each category.

Login credentials: ga / password123
